buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
title: Germany – Business and management consultancy and related services – 10047662-Technical Services to Strengthen Integrated, Inclusive and Climate Justice-Oriented Urban Development in Brazil
description: In Brazil, 87.4% of the population lives in urban areas, according to the 2022 Census of the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE), concentrating both the challenges and opportunities of sustainable urban development. Territorial inequalities remain significant: urban peripheries and Amazonian cities face more limited access to sanitation, drainage, and mobility, while also being more exposed to extreme weather events and increasing pressure on ecosystems. In Brazil"s North region, only 46.4% of the population has access to adequate wastewater services, even though approximately 70% of the Amazonian population lives in urban areas. In addition, nearly 20% of residents in favelas and informal settlements live on streets without vehicle access, compared to only 1.4% outside these areas. More than half of these residents also lack access to urban drainage infrastructure. The bilateral BMZ cooperation project "Sustainable Urban Development in Brazil III" (DUS III), implemented by GIZ in partnership with the Ministry of Cities (MCID), expands the results of its previous phase (DUS II) by scaling the Integrated Urban Development (IUD) approach in priority territories, with a particular focus on urban peripheries and Amazonian cities. The project promotes the integration of sectoral policies, including housing, mobility, sanitation, environment, and economic development, while aligning planning, financing, and implementation process. It also strengthens coordination across levels of government and applies a place-based approach to generate urban, social, economic, and environmental impacts. Its objective is to expand access to infrastructure and services, reduce climate vulnerabilities, and promote social participation in urban decision-making, thereby contributing to inclusion, economic dynamism, and climate justice in Brazilian cities. GIZ intends to contract services to structurally strengthen a socio-economic and climate resilient just transition in Amazonian cities and urban peripheries in Brazil, at both national and subnational levels, supporting: 1. Integrated and inclusive urban development to promote economic opportunities in Amazonian cities. 2. Integrated and inclusive urban development in urban peripheries; and 3. Support national programmes and governance structures to replicate local approaches.

title: Germany – Underground work other than tunnels, shafts and subways – Neubau Sekundärnetz Haar - Vergabe von Bauleistungen
description: Die Bayernwerk Natur GmbH und die Stadtwerke Haar GmbH haben eine Gesellschaft gegründet, namentlich die hiesige Auftraggeberin Wärmeversorgung Haar GmbH. Die neue Gesellschaft hat zum Ziel, der Stadt Haar eine nachhaltige Wärmeversorgung zu bieten und stellt damit einen bedeutenden Schritt in Richtung Wärmewende dar. Ein neues Netz, das sogenannte Sekundärnetz Haar, soll 2027 und 2028 gebaut werden. Die Stadtwerke kümmern sich um die kaufmännischen Aufgaben, Bayernwerk Natur ist für die Planung, den Bau, die Inbetriebnahmen sowie auch für den Betrieb als Dienstleister zuständig. Das Netz wird ab dem Heizwerk der Bayernwerk Natur im nördlichen Teil von Haar er-richtet und endet im südlichen Teil von Haar. Die genaue Beschreibung des Netzes ist der Projektbeschreibung (dort Ziff. 3 „Lage und Standort des Wärmenetzsystems“) zu entnehmen. Eigentümerin des Wärmenetzes ist die Wärmeversorgung Haar GmbH. Eigentümerin der Wärmeerzeugungsanlagen ist die Bayernwerk Natur GmbH (nachfolgend auch: „BAGN“). Die Hausübergabestationen werden von der BAGN bestellt und beigestellt. Soweit bei einzelnen Wärmekunden Wärmespeicher erforderlich sind, werden diese entweder vom jeweiligen Kunden selbst oder – bei den städtischen Gebäuden – von der BAGN beschafft. Die Lieferung der Hausübergabestationen und der Wärmespeicher ist nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung; die Schnittstelle der Bauleistung ergibt sich aus der Projektbeschreibung (dort Ziff. 4). Die Speicher sind dezentral neben den Übergabestationen meist in einem Heizungs- oder Technikraum im Keller untergebracht. Gegenstand des Verfahrens sind die erforderlichen Bauleistungen (Gewerke Tiefbau, Rohrleitungsbau einschließlich Schweiß- und Muffenarbeiten (Nachdämmung) sowie Straßenbau/Oberflächenwiederherstellung) für das Sekundärnetz Haar. Ausgeschrieben werden die Bauabschnitte 1 und 3 einschließlich der 14 Hausanschlüsse. Der bereits ausgeführte Bauabschnitt 2 sowie die Leitungsverlegung in der Unterführung der Deutschen Bahn sind nicht Gegenstand dieses Verfahrens (vgl. Projektbeschreibung, Ziff. 3), ebenso die Verlegung in der Bahnhofstraße ab der B304 (nördlich) bis zu den Parkplätzen der Kirche St. Konrad. Die Leistungen werden als Gesamtauftrag vergeben. Der Baubeginn ist für den 15.03.2027 vorgesehen. Das gesamte Netz einschließlich der 14 Hausanschlüsse ist im Jahr 2027 und 2028 fertigzustellen (vgl. Projektbeschreibung, Ziff. 7). Umfang und Einzelheiten der Leistungen ergeben sich aus der Projektbeschreibung und dem Leistungsverzeichnis. Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass das Leistungsverzeichnis nicht mit Position 3 endet. Die nachfolgenden Positionen umfassen die Hausanschlüsse einschließlich der erforderlichen Arbeiten innerhalb der Gebäude. Darüber hinaus befindet sich Position 1 betreffend die Vorbemerkungen derzeit noch in der Ausarbeitung. Das finale Leistungsverzeichnis wird mit der Aufforderung zur Angebotsabgabe übermittelt.

title: Germany – Professional services for the gas industry – Evakuierungsarbeiten von Pipelines zum Gastransport, Abfackeln von Restmengen, Inertisieren von Pipelines zum Gastransport Im Rahmen einer nicht abschließenden Rahmenvereinbarung
description: Evakuierungsarbeiten von Pipelines zum Gastransport Abfackeln von Restmengen Inertisieren von Pipelines zum Gastransport Im Rahmen einer nicht abschließenden Rahmenvereinbarung (1) GASCADE Gastransport GmbH und (2) NEL Gastransport GmbH (NGT) sind unabhängige Fernleitungsnetzbetreiber mit Sitz in Kassel, Deutschland. Die Auftraggeber sind Tochtergesellschaften der Wiga Transport Beteiligungs-GmbH & Co. KG, die wiederum zur SEFE Securing Energy for Europe GmbH gehört. GASCADE und NGT transportieren Erdgas und Wasserstoff sicher, zuverlässig und effizient durch ihre Pipelinesysteme. Die Auftraggeber spielen eine wichtige Rolle bei der Förderung einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft und unterstützen den Aufbau eines Wasserstoff-Netzes in Deutschland und Europa. Die Auftraggeber sind auch an verschiedenen Projekten beteiligt, die zur Verbesserung der Gasinfrastruktur und zur Unterstützung der Energiewende beitragen. Die EU-Methanregulierung verpflichtet die Auftraggeber als Fernleitungsnetzbetreiber alle Maßnahmen möglichst Emissionsfrei durchzuführen. Der Einsatz von mobilen Umpumpverdichtern, Fackel und anschließender Inertisierung bietet den Auftraggebern die Möglichkeit, Arbeiten an den Assets mit möglichst geringen Emissionen durchzuführen. Dieses Leistungsverzeichnis beschreibt die Erbringung von drei Arbeitsschritten: das Evakuieren, Abfackeln und Inertisieren. Das Medium ist Erdgas und Wasserstoff der 5. Gasfamilie nach G260. Die mobilen Einheiten sollen über flexible Schlauchleitungen oder Chiksan Leitungen angeschlossen werden können. Das Verbrauchsgas sowie die evakuierte/abgefackelte Menge soll gemessen und dokumentiert werden. Die Rahmenvereinbarung tritt mit Zuschlagserteilung durch den oder die Auftraggeber in Kraft, wobei sich die Auftraggeber gegenseitig vertreten können. Der Zuschlag zum Abschluss, der nicht abschließenden Rahmenvereinbarung wird, allen Bietern erteilt, die nicht auszuschließen sind, die geforderten Eignungsanforderungen erfüllen, die Rahmenvereinbarung vorbehaltlos akzeptieren und für mindestens ein beantragtes Leis-tungspaket sämtliche Mindestanforderungen erfüllen. Eine Preiswertung findet im Verfahren zum Abschluss der Rahmenvereinbarung nicht statt. Die Vergabestelle schätzt das anstehende Auftragsvolumen über die Laufzeit auf EUR 15.000.000,00. Der Gesamtwert aller Einzelaufträge aus der Rahmenvereinbarung ist daher auf den Höchstwert von EUR 20.000.000,00 netto begrenzt. Nach Erreichen des Höchstwerts dürfen keine weiteren Einzelaufträge auf Grundlage der Rahmenvereinbarung vergeben werden. Die Auftraggeber führen eine gemeinsame fortlaufende Abrufkontrolle. Der Ausführungszeitraum der einzelnen konkreten Beauftragungen wird bei Bedarf mittels Mini-Wettbewerb bekannt gegeben. Die Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung endet, ohne dass es einer Kündigung bedarf, wenn der Höchstwert oder die Höchstmenge der Rahmenvereinbarung durch die Vergabe von Einzelaufträgen erschöpft ist oder nach 8 Jahren, je nachdem, welches Ereignis früher eintritt. Weitere Details siehe Vergabeunterlagen.

Zu den Leistungen des Generalplaners zählen voraussichtlich die folgenden Leistungen bzw. Leistungsbilder: - Leistungsbild Bebauungsplan in Anlehnung an § 19 HOAI 2021; - Leistungsbild Grünordnungsplan in Anlehnung an § 24 HOAI 2021; - Leistungsbild Landschaftspflegerischer Begleitplan in Anlehnung an § 26 HOAI 2021; - Leistungsbild Flächennutzungsplan in Anlehnung an § 18 HOAI 2021 (voraussichtlich optional). Darüber hinaus hat der Generalplaner voraussichtlich auch Besondere Leistungen zur Flächenplanung zu erbringen.

title: Netherlands – Noise-control consultancy services – Sanering wegverkeerslawaai
description: Op basis van de saneringsvoorraad heeft de Aanbestedende dienst besloten om woningen met een te hoge geluidsbelasting vanwege wegverkeerslawaai te saneren. De woningen zijn gemeld en zijn opgenomen in de Eindmelding wegverkeerslawaai en de zogenaamde B-lijst. Om de geluidsbelasting op de gevels van de betrokken woningen te bepalen is in opdracht van de gemeente door een externe adviseur een akoestisch onderzoek opgesteld. Dit onderzoek heeft gediend als basis van de aanvraag voor de voorbereidingssubsidie bij het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (IenW). De Aanbestedende dienst wil één opdrachtnemer contracteren voor het uitvoeren en begeleiden van geluidsaneringsprojecten. De scope van deze opdracht bestaat uit de volgende fasen: • Het inventariseren van de woningen; • Het uitvoeren van akoestische berekeningen; • Het opstellen van een maatregel voorstel; • Het begeleiden van de uitvoering. Overzicht van de 4 projecten welke onderdeel uitmaken van deze aanbesteding: Biest e.o.: In dit project zijn 71 woningen opgenomen. Bij dit project dienen in totaal 61 woningen bouw-kundig te worden opgenomen. Bij 10 woningen is de geluidbelasting lager dan 63 dB. Deze wo-ningen kunnen worden geschouwd. Maaseikerweg: In dit project zijn 88 woningen opgenomen. Bij dit project dienen in totaal 83 woningen bouw-kundig te worden opgenomen. Bij 5 woningen is de geluidbelasting lager dan 63 dB. Deze wo-ningen kunnen worden geschouwd. Roermondseweg: In dit project zijn 142 woningen opgenomen. Bij dit project dienen in totaal 137 woningen bouw-kundig te worden opgenomen. Bij 5 woningen is de geluidbelasting lager dan 63 dB. Deze wo-ningen kunnen worden geschouwd. Wilhelminasingel: In dit project zijn 59 woningen opgenomen. Bij dit project dienen in totaal 36 woningen bouw-kundig te worden opgenomen. Bij 23 woningen is de geluidbelasting lager dan 63 dB. Deze wo-ningen kunnen worden geschouwd.

title: Denmark – Surveillance and security systems and devices – Overfaldsalarmsystem samt tilhørende udstyr til det sociale område i Region Syddanmark
description: Udbuddet vedrører kontrakt om et Overfaldsalarmsystem samt tilhørende udstyr til Regionens personale og borgere inklusive installation, drift og vedligeholdelse af Udstyr og programmel. Overfaldsalarmsystem skal anvendes til ca. 1.750 medarbejdere med ca. 500 samtidige brugere/medarbejdere fordelt på 20 lokationer (detaljeret information omkring lokationerne følger af udbudsbetingelserne). Kunden ønsker med den kommende Kontrakt at indkøbe en fremtidssikret, sammenhængende Overfaldsalarmsystem, der skal bidrage til at øge personalesikkerheden. Kundens hensigt med anskaffelsen er at optimere og modernisere det borgernære omsorgsarbejde på centrene samt sikre et trygt arbejdsmiljø for personalet. Kunden ønsker en løsning, der kan advisere personalet om både aktivt- og passivt udløste alarmer og nødkald ifm. indtrufne hændelser, eksempelvis når en medarbejder eller en borger aktiverer alarmer og nødkald. Løsningen forventes også at kunne advisere personalet om potentielt forestående hændelser som eksempelvis atypisk og potentielt uhensigtsmæssig adfærd hos borgere. Overfaldsalarmsystem omfatter: • Personalesikring med overfaldsalarm og kollegahjælp for personale på centrene. • Beboer nød- og servicekald på centrene. • Positionering på rum- og zoneniveau. • Sikring af centrene med automatisk genererede alarmer, når beboer passerer bygningsafsnit, yderdøre og matrikelafgrænsning. • App-løsning til smartphone og tablet (iOS/Android) til modtagelse af alarmer. • Vedligeholdelse og fejlafhjælpning af Udstyr og administrationssystem. Det efterspurgte Overfaldsalarmsystem omfatter således alt nødvendigt og relevant udstyr og infrastrukturelementer samt aktiviteter forbundet med implementering, opsætning og vedligeholdelse af Udstyr. Overfaldsalarmsystemet omfatter endvidere Kundens adgang til selvstændigt at administrere og konfigurere løsningen via et passende administrationsmodul. Tilbudsgiver skal tilbyde installation på følgende yderligere lokationer som optioner: • Bihuset Døgn • Bihuset Aflastning • Nymarksvej • Røjleskov • Egely • Lunden Kunden har besluttet ikke at opdele kontrakten i delkontrakter, da der er et vist funktionelt overlap mellem kontraktens omfattede ydelser. Kunden har derfor vurderet det mest hensigtsmæssigt, at den samlede løsning leveres i samme kontrakt, da dette vil give mulighed for at foretage samlet administration af løsningen, hvilket understøtter effektive arbejdsgange hos Kunden. Se forventet tidsplan for projektet i tidsplanen i udbudsmaterialet.

title: Netherlands – Construction work – Nieuwbouw busstalling Beverwaard

Het zou een forse investering vergen om deze stalling en werkplaats weer voor langere tijd op het juiste niveau te brengen. Daarnaast dient de RET-busvloot per 2030 volledig uitstootvrij te zijn. Dit is landelijk afgesproken in het Bestuursakkoord Zero Emissie Busvervoer. De instroom van batterij-elektrische bussen vraagt om het realiseren van extra energievoorziening en laadinfrastructuur, wat op de locatie Sluisjesdijk kostbaar, risicovol en door netcongestie momenteel onmogelijk is. Daarom is een vergelijking gemaakt tussen het renoveren van de Sluisjesdijk en het realiseren van een nieuwe busstalling met werkplaats op een andere locatie. Hiervoor is in overleg met Gemeente Rotterdam en de MRDH een terrein naast de tramremise Beverwaard geselecteerd. Gebleken is dat nieuwbouw op deze locatie gunstiger is dan het aanpassen van de busstalling Sluisjesdijk. In augustus 2025 heeft het Directieteam RET ingestemd met de realisatie van de nieuwe busstalling op de locatie Beverwaard. De nieuwe busstalling komt op één van de kavels in de Zuidpunt Beverwaard, gelegen aan de Edo Bergsmaweg in Rotterdam. Zie onderstaande figuur. De huurovereenkomst tussen Gemeente Rotterdam en de RET is ondertekend en de RET is dan ook zeker van de locatie.

Zu den Leistungen des Generalplaners zählen voraussichtlich die folgenden Leistungen bzw. Leistungsbilder: - Leistungsbild Bebauungsplan in Anlehnung an § 19 HOAI 2021; - Leistungsbild Grünordnungsplan in Anlehnung an § 24 HOAI 2021; - Leistungsbild Landschaftspflegerischer Begleitplan in Anlehnung an § 26 HOAI 2021; - Leistungsbild Flächennutzungsplan in Anlehnung an § 18 HOAI 2021 (voraussichtlich optional). title: Level 2 Sexual Health Services - Breckland/South Norfolk
description: Level 2 Sexual Health Service (STI Testing and Treatment) - South Norfolk/Breckland Locality Norfolk County Council Public Health intends to commission a community-based Level 2 Sexual Health Service within the South Norfolk/Breckland locality. The proposed service will build upon existing Primary Care-based sexual health provision and expand the scope of delivery to include the assessment, testing and treatment of symptomatic but uncomplicated sexually transmitted infections (STIs). The service is intended to improve access to local sexual health services, particularly within rural and geographically dispersed communities, whilst supporting integration with existing Norfolk sexual health pathways and referral arrangements. The service has been developed in response to identified local need and will focus specifically on the South Norfolk/Breckland population. Providers expressing an interest should therefore be able to demonstrate an appropriate delivery model, geographical footprint, workforce capacity, clinical capability and governance arrangements necessary to deliver the service across the required locality. The proposed contract term is four (4) years with an indicative annual contract value of approximately £103,500, representing an estimated total contract value of £414,000 over the full contract term. The contract is expected to operate on an activity-based payment model. This procurement is being undertaken under Direct Award Process B of the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023 Interested providers should be able to demonstrate: · Appropriate clinical capability to deliver a Level 2 Sexual Health Service. · Sufficient workforce capacity and resilience. · Robust clinical governance and safeguarding arrangements. · Experience of delivering sexual health and STI services. · Ability to provide accessible services within the South Norfolk/Breckland locality. · Integration with existing sexual health pathways, laboratory services and referral arrangements. The Authority notes that alternative sexual health provision already exists elsewhere within Norfolk and therefore this opportunity is specifically focused on addressing the needs of the South Norfolk/Breckland locality. Providers wishing to express an interest will be invited to provide information regarding their capability, capacity and proposed delivery model for the service.

title: ACAN - Preventative Maintenance for Orbitrap ID-X Mass Spectrometer and Ultra-high performance liquid chromatograph (UHPLC) Instruments
description: 1. Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN) An ACAN is a public notice indicating to the supplier community that Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada intends to award a contract for services to a pre-identified supplier, thereby allowing other suppliers to signal their interest in bidding, by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in the ACAN, on or before the closing date stated in the ACAN, the Contracting Authority may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 2. Definition of the requirement The Department of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada has a requirement for Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. to provide preventative maintenance services for one (1) Orbitrap ID-X, IC Ready Mass Spectrometer (Serial Number FSN30102) connected with Vanquish Binary Pump, Vanquish Split Sampler FT, and Vanquish Column Compartment H located at the Morden Research and Development Centre. The service will involve the following under an Essential Support Plan: - Field Service Engineer labor, travel, and parts required for any unlimited Corrective Maintenance visits within a 72h response time. - Technical Support inquiries with a targeted immediate response time provided by a certified service engineer using the latest digital remote support tools. - One (1) scheduled annual standard Preventive Maintenance visit including replacement parts (Standard PM Kit included). - Instrument Requalification (RQ) in conjunction with a scheduled Corrective Maintenance with a purchase of an add-on Operational Qualification. - Access to Unity Lab Services Online Knowledge Base subscription. - Software and firmware updates upon request and in conjunction with a scheduled Preventative Maintenance or Corrective Maintenance visit. - 10% discount on spare parts not covered by Corrective Maintenance, and accessories and consumables for the instruments, and 10% discounts off list price for any training classes purchased during the contract period. 3. Criteria for assessment of the Statement of Capabilities (Minimum Essential Requirements) Any interested supplier must demonstrate by way of a statement of capabilities that it meets the following requirements: - Are an authorized vendor who are certified and authorized to maintain and repair Orbitrap ID-X Mass Spectrometers and UHPLC Instruments to restore instruments operating as intended. 4. Applicability of the trade agreement(s) to the procurement This procurement is subject to the following trade agreement(s): ? Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA) ? Canada-Chile Free Trade Agreement (CCFTA) ? Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement ? Canada-Honduras Free Trade Agreement ? Canada-Korea Free Trade Agreement ? Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement ? Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement (CPFTA) 5. Justification for the Pre-Identified Supplier Thermo Fisher Scientific owns the design of this equipment. There is no other company that can provide parts, training, service or repairs because the architecture and technology belong to Thermo Fisher Scientific. Since Thermo Fisher is the original manufacturer of this equipment, they are the only company that have trained service engineers that are qualified to do the trouble shooting and repairs on their technology should something break down. 6. Government Contracts Regulations Exception(s) The following exception(s) to the Government Contracts Regulations is invoked for this procurement under subsection. 6.(d) - "only one person or firm is capable of performing the work". Where, for works of art, or for reasons connected with the protection of patents, copyrights or other exclusive rights, or proprietary information or where there is an absence of competition for technical reasons, the goods or services can be supplied only by a particular supplier and no reasonable alternative or substitute exists. 7. Exclusions and/or Limited Tendering Reasons The following exclusion(s) and/or limited tendering reasons are invoked under the: ? Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA) – Article(s) 513 (b) ii ? Canada-Chile Free Trade Agreement (CCFTA) – Article(s) Kbis-09 (b) ? Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement – Article(s) 1409 1. (b) ? Canada-Honduras Free Trade Agreement – Article(s) 17.11 (b) (i) ? Canada-Korea Free Trade Agreement – referencing the WTO Protocol Amending the GPA, Article XIII (1) (b) ? Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement – Article(s) 16.10 (b) (ii) ? Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement (CPFTA) – Article(s) 1409 (b) (ii) 8. Period of the proposed contract The proposed contract is for a period of 3 years, from estimated start date: January 15, 2027 to estimated completion date: January 14, 2030. 9. Cost estimate of the proposed contract The estimated value of the contract is $ 223,853.05 (including all applicable taxes). 10. Name and address of the pre-identified supplier Thermo Fisher Scientific (Mississauga) Inc. 4-2845 Argentia Road MISSISSAUGA, ON L5N 8G6 11. Suppliers' right to submit a statement of capabilities Suppliers who consider themselves fully qualified and available to provide the services described in the ACAN may submit a statement of capabilities in writing by Email to the Contracting Authority identified in this notice on or before the closing date of this notice. The statement of capabilities must clearly demonstrate how the supplier meets the advertised requirements. 12. Closing date for a submission of a statement of capabilities. The closing date and time for accepting statements of capabilities is December 1 at 11:00 a.m., CST. 13. Inquiries and statements of capabilities are to be directed to: Melissa Smith Procurement Specialist Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada Western Service Centre Telephone: 306-515-4796 Email address: melissa.smith3@agr.gc.ca Please note that the Department of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada will not accept hard copy submissions. Email submissions must be less than 20 MB; if the file(s) are larger please split them into more than one email. Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. The Department is not responsible for misdirected or delayed submissions. All submissions must be received by the closing date and time specified above. All submissions should note the following file number in the subject line of the e-mail: # WSC-2627-200 Statement of Capabilities received on or before the closing date will be considered solely for the purpose of deciding whether or not to conduct a competitive procurement. Information provided will be used by AAFC for technical evaluation purposes only, and will not to be construed as a proposal. Your written Statement of Capabilities must provide sufficient evidence that demonstrates it is capable of fulfilling AAFCs requirement. B. Menge, Lieferzeit, Lieferort, Zuschlagskriterien etc.), sofern diese nicht bereits in der Bekanntmachung veröffentlicht wurden. Mit Abgabe eines Angebots erklärt der Bieter, dass keine Änderungen in den Eignungskriterien erfolgen. Der Bieter mit dem auf Grundlage der mitgeteilten Zuschlagskriterien zu ermittelnden wirtschaftlichsten Angebot erhält den Zuschlag. title: Ireland – Electrical machinery, apparatus, equipment and consumables; lighting – Dublin City Council Multi-Party Framework Agreement for the provision of Electrical Wholesale Goods and Equipment
description: Dublin City Council proposes to establish a multi-operator framework agreement for the supply and delivery of electrical wholesale goods and equipment to support the operation and maintenance of public lighting, housing electrical services and electrical installations across the Council’s estate. The framework will be established with up to three economic operators. The framework will be primarily utilised by Dublin City Council’s Public Lighting and Electrical Services, which manages approximately 47,000 public lighting units, electrical services to over 30,000 residential dwellings and electrical installations across more than 300 public buildings. The scope of the framework includes the supply and delivery of a wide range of electrical wholesale goods and equipment, including but not limited to: • Public lighting lanterns • Cables and wires • Cable accessories, jointing materials, fixings and supports • Conduit, trunking and containment systems • Connectors, terminals and electrical accessories • Fuses, fusegear, circuit breakers and protective devices • Switches, isolators and control equipment • Lamps, control gear and lighting components • Internal and external light fittings • Enclosures and distribution equipment • Batteries • Domestic fire detection and alarm devices, including smoke, heat and carbon monoxide alarms • Proprietary spare parts for repair and maintenance activities • Electrical machines and appliances • Other associated electrical products specified during the framework term All goods supplied must be new, unused, fit for purpose and compliant with applicable Irish, European or equivalent international standards. The framework will operate for a period of four years. The initial contract is expected to be awarded for two years, with the option to extend for up to two further one-year periods, subject to satisfactory performance. The estimated maximum value of the framework is €9,000,000 excluding VAT. This figure is indicative only and does not constitute a guarantee of expenditure. The Contracting Authority makes no commitment regarding the volume or value of orders that may arise during the framework term. The successful framework members will be required to provide reliable delivery services across Dublin City Council locations. Frequent-use items must be available for next-business-day delivery, while stock items must generally be available within three working days of receipt of an official order. The framework will support the ongoing delivery of essential public services and infrastructure across Dublin City Council’s operations. Tenderers will be required to demonstrate appropriate financial standing, technical capacity, quality assurance arrangements, business continuity measures and relevant experience in the supply of comparable electrical goods and equipment. This competition is being conducted through the Open Procedure in accordance with Irish and EU public procurement requirements. For further information please refer to documentation available to download from www.etenders.gov.ie Resource ID 9375229. Please note that this project is subject to funding.

title: AI-Enabled Support
description: The 48th Contracting Squadron (48 CONS) at RAF Lakenheath, on behalf of the 100th Maintenance Group (100 MXG) and the 100th Logistics Readiness Squadron (100 LRS) at RAF Mildenhall, United Kingdom, is conducting market research to identify commercial vendors capable of delivering an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled maintenance decision-support and edge computing software platform. The Government requires an enterprise-capable, commercial software platform designed to ingest and modularize complex technical data�including aircraft Technical Orders (TOs), commercial and military vehicle maintenance manuals, historical maintenance records, and real-time vehicle telematics / Controller Area Network (CANbus) data. The objective is to guide maintenance technicians through step-by-step troubleshooting, diagnostic isolation, and repair workflows on ruggedized mobile edge devices in both connected and disconnected operational environments. 48 CONS is seeking information about what commercially available or production-ready solutions currently exist across industry, and is interested in understanding the technological capabilities, commercial licensing models, deployment timelines, and cybersecurity maturity (e.g., Risk Management Framework / Authority to Operate pathways) that industry can offer. This announcement constitutes an RFI for informational and planning purposes only. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP), nor is it to be construed as a commitment by the Government. No contract will be awarded as a result. Industry�s response to the RFI?�or lack thereof�will have no impact on the evaluation of responses to any subsequent RFP or Request for Quote (RFQ) released. The information requested will be used within 48 CONS as market research to facilitate decision making (e.g., determining acquisition strategy, small business concerns) and will not be disclosed outside the Government. Proprietary information submitted shall be appropriately marked. Do not submit confidential information in your response. **Note** 48 CONS/ will NOT be responsible for any costs incurred by interested parties responding to this RFI.

title: Cedar Shingle Roof Replacement, Ardgowan National Historic Site.
description: 5P468-26-0294/A Cedar Shingle Roof Replacement, Ardgowan National Historic Site. BIDS RECEIVED BY FAX AND EMAIL WILL BE ACCEPTED AS OFFICIAL. PARKS CANADA IS NOT CURRENTLY ACCEPTING BIDS VIA SAP ARIBA, YOU MUST SUBMIT YOUR BID VIA FAX OR EMAIL AS INDICATED IN THE SOLICITATION DOCUMENT. BIDS RECEIVED IN-PERSON OR BY COURIER WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. The only acceptable email address for responses to the bid solicitation issoumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca . Bids submitted by email directly to the Contracting Authority or to any email address other than soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca will not be accepted. The only acceptable facsimile for responses to bid solicitations is 1-855-983-1808. The maximum email file size that Parks Canada is capable of receiving is 15 megabytes. The Bidder is responsible for any failure attributable to the transmission or receipt of the emailed bid due to file size. The Bidder should be cognisant of the size of the email as a whole, and not only the attachments. Please take into consideration that some attachments, when sent, may be resized during the email transfer. If the email size is too large, the Bidder should send the bid in multiple emails properly labeled with the solicitation number, project name, and indicate how many emails are included (ex. 1 of 2). Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. Bid documents must be sent as email attachments. REQUIREMENT The work encompasses cedar shingle replacement, flashing replacement and integration, ventilation upgrades, and exterior wood conservation at three (3) subject roof areas TWO-SUBMISSION BID This Bid shall be submitted following a “two-submission” procedure. Refer to SI04 of the Special Instructions to Bidders. CONTRACTOR SELECTION AND INDIGENOUS PARTICIPATION PLAN The Contractor should ensure provision of specific and agreed upon benefits for Indigenous People and Indigenous Businesses in the Area of the Contract. This Invitation to Tender contains bid criteria in order to provide socioeconomic benefits to Indigenous communities within the area covered by the contract. PERIOD OF CONTRACT / DELIVERY DATE Contractor must perform and complete the Work no later than March 31, 2027. OPTIONAL SITE VISIT Arrangements have been made for the site visit to be held at 2 Palmers Lane, Charlottetown, PE C1A 5V8. on November 24, 2026. The site visit will begin at 10:00 AM AST. Bidders must communicate with the Contracting Authority no later than November 23 at 4:00 PM to confirm attendance and provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend. Bidders who do not confirm attendance provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend will not be allowed access to the site. Bidders will be requested to sign an attendance sheet. No alternative appointment will be given to bidders who do not attend or do not send a representative. Bidders who do not participate in the visit will not be precluded from submitting a bid. Any clarifications or changes to the bid solicitation resulting from the site visit will be included as an amendment to the bid solicitation. ENQUIRIES All enquiries of a technical and contractual nature are to be submitted to the Contracting Authority. Enquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing and should be received no later than five (5) Business days prior to the date set for solicitation closing to allow sufficient time to provide a response. Enquiries received after that time may result in an answer NOT being provided. INFORMATION National Parks Regulations require that all work is to be performed in accordance with the ordinances, laws, rules and regulations set out in the National Park Act. Bidders that consider themselves qualified to provide this Work and intend to submit bids on this project should obtain documents from the Government Electronic Tendering Service through the Government of Canada tendering service at http://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities. Addenda, when issued, will be available from the Government of Canada tendering service. Bidders that elect to base their bids on documents obtained from other sources do so at their own risk. Late submissions will not be considered. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Parks Canada has made every effort to provide equivalent documents in both official languages, however, if you find any discrepancies between the English and French documents, please notify the contract officer listed in this opportunity as soon as possible so that we can rectify the situation.

description: In accordance with the provisions of Directive 2014/25/EU (the Utilities Directive as implemented by Executive Order no. 1078 of 29 June 2022 on procurement by entities operating in the water, energy, transport and postal services sectors), a framework agreement for supply of fasteners and rail pads for the sleeper types: S99/SB89 and S16/SB16 for use in the Danish rail network as well as the product type acceptance process for the offered sleepers and rail pads is put out to tender. The execution of the Framework Agreement is divided into three phases: (1) Design, Validation and Product Type Acceptance Phase (2) Retrofitting of Sleeper Factory Phase (3) Manufacturing and Delivery Production Phase. The framework agreement gives Banedanmark a right, but not an obligation, to order the above-mentioned fasteners and rail pads. The Framework Agreement is exclusive regarding supply of fasteners to be used at Banedanmark's Sleeper Factory. Fasteners to be used in connection with maintenance and replacement of existing fasteners in Banedanmark’s infrastructure are not covered by this agreement. For more information reference is made to the tender material.

title: Pohjanmaan Pelastuslaitoksen nostureiden perusteelliset määräaikaistarkastukset (10-vuotistarkastus) - Grundlig periodisk inspektion (10-årskontroll) av Österbottens Räddningsverks kranar
description: Nostolaitteille pitää Valtioneuvoston asetuksen 403/2008 § 35 mukaan tehdä perusteellinen määräaikaistarkastus kerran 10:ssä vuodessa. Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue pyytää tarjousta yhteensä kuuden (6 kpl) Pohjanmaan pelastuslaitoksen nosturin perusteellisesta määräaikaistarkastuksesta. Optiona pyydetään myös tuntihinta mahdollisille korjaustöille. Tarkastuksen kohteena olevat nosturit ovat seuraavat: 1. Palfinger PC 2300 A, vuosimalli 2005 2. Ferrari F 560 A2, vuosimalli 2005 3. Effer 2500 A2, vuosimalli 1987 4. Palfinger PC 1500 A, vuosimalli 2016 5. Hiab 650 AW, vuosimalli 1989 6. Hiab-Foco Hiab 007, vuosimalli 1996 Lisätietoa nostureiden sijoituspaikoista liitteestä 1. title: Luxembourg – Construction work – Bauausführung eines "Centre Médical" als Generalunternehmer mit Ausführungsplanung in Wincrange
description: Die Gemeinde beabsichtigt am Standort "45, Haaptstrooss, L-9780 Wincrange" in Ergänzung zum dem bestehenden „Centre Médical I" ein weiteres Gesundheitszentrum („Centre Médical II", „CMW") mit Fachärzten, Jugendpsychiatrie, Kinésitherapie, Pediküre und Fitness einzurichten, mit dem übergeordneten Ziel die gesundheitliche Grundversorgung sicher zu stellen. Das Gebäude soll aus drei Etagen mit Dachgeschoss (Technik, Lager) und Keller (Technik, Lager) bestehen und in Massivbauweise errichtet werden. Im Erdgeschoss soll die Jugendpsychiatrie angeordnet wer-den. Im 1.OG sollen die Praxen für Fachärzte und Physiotherapeuten, sowie die Behandlungsräu-me der Pediküre eingerichtet werden. im 2.OG sollen Flächen für ein Fitnessstudie entstehen. Diese Ausschreibung umfasst die Ausführungsplanung und die Ausführungen der schlüsselfertigen Gebäude inkl. Außenanlagen gem. den Vorgaben des Auftraggebers.

title: Denmark – Sleepers and parts of sleepers – 2nd re-tender for fasteners and rail pads for the sleeper types: S99, SB16 & S16 for use in the Danish rail network
description: In accordance with the provisions of Directive 2014/25/EU (the Utilities Directive as implemented by Executive Order no. 1078 of 29 June 2022 on procurement by entities operating in the water, energy, transport and postal services sectors), a framework agreement for supply of fasteners and rail pads for the sleeper types: S99/SB89 and S16/SB16 for use in the Danish rail network as well as the product type acceptance process for the offered sleepers and rail pads is put out to tender. The execution of the Framework Agreement is divided into three phases: (1) Design, Validation and Product Type Acceptance Phase (2) Retrofitting of Sleeper Factory Phase (3) Manufacturing and Delivery Production Phase. The framework agreement gives Banedanmark a right, but not an obligation, to order the above-mentioned fasteners and rail pads. The Framework Agreement is exclusive regarding supply of fasteners to be used at Banedanmark's Sleeper Factory. Fasteners to be used in connection with maintenance and replacement of existing fasteners in Banedanmark’s infrastructure are not covered by this agreement. For more information reference is made to the tender material.

title: Finland – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Porthania, irtokalustesuunnittelu
description: Helsingin Yliopistokiinteistöt Oy (HYK) peruskorjaa Porthania-rakennuksen. Peruskorjaus toteutetaan allianssihankkeena. Rakennuksen päävuokralainen Helsingin yliopisto hankkii irtokalustehankintoja ja olemassa olevien, alkuperäisten irtokalusteiden kunnostusta ja sijoittelua palvelevan sisustussuunnittelun. Alkuperäiset kalusteet muodostavat merkittävän osan kokonaissuunnitelmasta eikä suunnittelutehtävää voida tämän vuoksi jakaa erikseen tarjottaviksi osa-alueiksi. Varustamisen tavoitteina on toiminnan tarpeita vastaava, ergonominen, viihtyisä, kestävä, huollettava, helppokäyttöinen ja muunneltava kalustus ja varustus, jonka suunnittelussa huomioidaan myös rakennuksen suojelutavoitteet niin säilyneen alkuperäiskalustuksen kuin interiöörien ilmeen osalta. Tilaaja edellyttää, että tarjoaja osallistuu kohteen esittelywebinaariin, joka järjestetään 25.11.2026 klo 12.15 - 13.00. Ilmoittautuminen webinaariin pe 20.11.2026 mennessä osoitteeseen hy247-hankinnat@helsinki.fi otsikolla " Porthania - webinaari".

description: Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC) requires a Contractor to provide dedicated mail transportation and delivery services between designated Canada Post, Service Canada, and ESDC locations in the Moncton, New Brunswick area. The Contractor must provide all vehicles, drivers, labour, and equipment necessary to ensure the secure and timely pickup, transportation, and delivery of mail and operational materials on scheduled daily routes, Monday to Friday, excluding statutory holidays. The resulting contract will be for an initial period of date of contract award to March 31, 2028, with three (3) optional extension periods of twelve (12) months each.

title: Language interpretation and note taking
description: The Contractor must provide, on request and within short notice periods, real-time computerized note-taking services and spoken-language interpretation services to support an employee with a hearing impairment. The services must enable the employee to fully participate in meetings, training sessions, workshops, conferences, and other work-related activities. Services may be required for meetings conducted in English, French, or both official languages and may be provided virtually (computerized note-taking) or in person (spoken-language interpretation) within the National Capital Region (NCR). The services consist of two distinct components: • Real-time computerized note-taking; • Spoken-language interpretation. For information purposes only, real-time computerized note-taking services are expected to be required on a regular basis throughout the contract period, whereas spoken-language interpretation services are expected to be required on an occasional basis as operational needs arise.

title: 25-58288 Free Running Submarine Model (FRSM)
description: Free Running Submarine Model (FRSM) The National Research Council of Canada’s Ocean, Coastal and River Engineering Research Centre (NRC-OCRE) has a requirement for one (1) Free Running Submarine Model (FRSM) for delivery to St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador. The FRSM will support NRC’s submarine hydrodynamics research for current and future submarine designs, enabling comprehensive testing in controlled and free-running environments. NRC encourages innovative solutions and does not prescribe a specific vehicle architecture. Offerors are expected to propose an integrated design that satisfies the operational, performance, and research objectives described in this Statement of Requirement. Background NRC’s Ocean, Coastal and River Engineering Research Centre (NRC-OCRE) conducts research in submarine hydrodynamics, vehicle dynamics, control systems, and operational safety using physical and numerical modelling techniques. Over the past two decades, NRC has developed and tested several scaled submarine models, including the “Albert” model, a free-running Victoria Class submarine research platform used to investigate hydrodynamic performance, handling characteristics, seakeeping behaviour, near-bottom operations, and related submarine operating scenarios. The Albert model and associated research programs generated extensive technical data, including hydrodynamic coefficients, vehicle response characteristics, instrumentation approaches, and operational experience with free-running submarine models. Technical reference data associated with the Albert model, including geometry and historical test data, will be made available to the successful Contractor. Traditional captive models provide valuable hydrodynamic data but are limited to predefined motions and controlled test conditions. NRC requires a Free Running Submarine Model (FRSM) to expand its research capabilities through autonomous and free-running operations. The FRSM will support hydrodynamic, propulsion, autonomy, control systems, and under-ice research while providing a flexible platform that can be adapted to evaluate current and future submarine designs. The primary research objectives of the FRSM are to: 1. Generate hydrodynamic coefficients and equations of motion for different submarine configurations and operating conditions. 2. Investigate and validate the operating characteristics of current and future submarine designs. 3. Evaluate failure modes, fault responses, and emergency operating scenarios. 4. Assess vehicle control, autonomy, navigation, and mission execution strategies. 5. Support research into under-ice operations, ice interaction, and surfacing-through-ice dynamics. The FRSM must be delivered with a 1:10 scale hull geometry based on the NRC-provided Albert model, representing a simplified Victoria Class submarine configuration. The platform must also support future reconfiguration to alternative submarine geometries. To support these objectives, the FRSM must provide the following core operational capabilities: Capability Purpose Free-running autonomous submarine operations Conduct manoeuvring and mission testing without captive restraints Reconfigurable submarine research platform Evaluate current and future submarine geometries Hydrodynamic and propulsion data collection Generate hydrodynamic performance data Autonomous navigation and mission execution Support autonomy, control, and mission-planning research Under-ice operation and surfacing Support ice-interaction and Arctic research Please see tender documents for details

title: Wharf Reconstruction Phase II – Port au Choix, NL
description: 1. TITLE Wharf Reconstruction – Port au Choix, NL for Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) 2. SCOPE OF WORK The work covered consists of the furnishing of all plant, labour, equipment and material for the reconstruction of approximately 73.2 meters of the marginal wharf at Port au Choix, NL in accordance with specifications and accompanying drawings and subject to all terms and conditions of the Contract. In general, the work under this contract consists of, but will not necessarily be limited to, the following: • Site Work including mobilization, demobilization, excavation, partial demolition and removal of existing crib work, hauling, and disposal offsite and onsite. • Required survey to set location of new Work as indicated on the drawings. • Dredging of overburden sediments from the harbour bottom to reach bedrock in the footprint of the rock mattress to be placed for the crib work. • Construction of timber cribwork on a placed rock mattress with associated rock ballast, fendering, wheelguard and blocking, Type “A” cleats and blocks, and ladders. • Electrical work as required and detailed for the provision of street lights, shore power pedestals and the installation of a new 600 AMP single phase electrical service. • Supply and placement of new quarried rock fill and Class “A” and Class “B” granular material. • Supply and placement of new asphalt pavement. • Supply and placement of scour protection. • Construction of reinforced concrete wharf deck and upland slab on grade. • Supply and placement of catch basins with outlet pipes for site drainage. • Removal, salvage and reinstallation of a precast concrete block retaining wall. 3. FAMILIARIZATION WITH SITE Before submitting a bid, it is recommended that bidders visit the site and its surroundings to review and verify the form, nature and extent of the work, materials necessary for the completion of the works, the means of access to the site, severity, exposure and uncertainty of weather, soil conditions, any accommodations they may require, and in general shall obtain all necessary information as to risks, contingencies and other circumstances which may influence or affect their bid. No allowance shall be made subsequently in this connection on account of error or negligence to properly observe and determine the conditions that will apply. Contractors, bidders or those they invite to site are to review specification Section 01 35 28 - Health and Safety Requirements before visiting site. Take all appropriate safety measures for any visit to site, either before or after acceptance of bid. 4. CONTRACT PERIOD It is anticipated the contractor can perform and complete the work no later than March 31, 2029. All work shall be completed in accordance with the Contract Documents.
